episodes.name: Empty Nest
episodes.overview: NCIS searches for a missing undercover agent in the midst of an active hostage situation.

episodes.name: Foreign Bodies
episodes.overview: As Vance prepares to host diplomatic talks with Venezuela, the team is called in to investigate the dead body of one of his inside men.

episodes.name: The Trouble with Hal
episodes.overview: NCIS is called in to investigate when a Lieutenant returns home on the eve of Halloween to find a surprise party being thrown for someone else at his place.

episodes.name: Sticks & Stones
episodes.overview: After receiving intelligence on deadly threats to multiple locations that could lead to a catastrophic war, NCIS is called in to try to neutralize the danger.

episodes.name: In from the Cold
episodes.overview: NCIS works with the CIA to discover what secrets are being kept by Captain Butler, an elderly former spy with dementia.

episodes.name: Knight and Day
episodes.overview: Things become tense when Knight is assigned to protect his wife after the home of a high-level defense contractor is attacked.

episodes.name: Hardboiled
episodes.overview: Torres receives intel from a confidential informant regarding top secret Naval information that's at risk of being sold.

episodes.name: Out of Control
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates a murder related to a car that begins driving on its own.

episodes.name: Humbug
episodes.overview: When a shocking tell-all threatens to ruin Christmas for a decorated Marine, NCIS must uncover the truth and deliver a holiday miracle - before the book hits shelves and turns a hero's legacy into a holiday disaster.

episodes.name: Baker's Man
episodes.overview: After NCIS learns that the owner of Parker's favorite bakery is being blackmailed, they hatch a plan to save her from the perpetrators.

episodes.name: For Better or Worse
episodes.overview: NCIS stages a fake wedding for two of its own in an attempt to take down the mob.

episodes.name: Fun and Games
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the fatal poisoning of one of Kasie's forensic scientists.

episodes.name: Bad Blood
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the case of a Navy Lieutenant found dead at a blood donation bank.

episodes.name: Close to Home
episodes.overview: When Torres receives a text from Jimmy's daughter saying she has discovered a large sum of money near a Naval library, the team works together to investigate.

episodes.name: Moonlit
episodes.overview: After a Navy Lieutenant's death reveals ties to Special Agent Sawyer, Torres and Knight uncover a murder linked to a wealthy family.

episodes.name: Ladies' Night
episodes.overview: A girls' night out takes an unexpected turn when NCIS is called to investigate the motive of a possible arsonist.

episodes.name: Killer Instinct
episodes.overview: After NCIS captures the hitman known as "The Poet," the team races to uncover who ordered the assassination of a Navy chief.

episodes.name: After the Storm
episodes.overview: When a trio of combat vets are found murdered in a D.C. motel room, NCIS tracks down a suspect who refuses to talk to anyone but Sam Hanna.

episodes.name: Irreconcilable Differences
episodes.overview: McGee's career and credibility are on the line when he investigates the Deputy Director for corruption.

episodes.name: Nexus
episodes.overview: As NCIS investigates a dangerous connection between the Nexus cartel and Parker's longtime nemesis, mob boss Carla Marino, the team uncovers a high-stakes plot involving stolen nuclear material.
